## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- claim-1 establishes the basis and relation lattice only for \(0\le k\le b=\min(i,j)\). The requested literal “each degree \(d+k\)” target is therefore not established.
- The draft itself acknowledges that degrees \(k>b\), including possible boundary one-term Pieri rows, remain untreated.

## Unresolved certificates
- [proof-attempt] Classify the interval Schur basis and complete positive-degree multiplication lattice for every remaining \(k>b\), or prove from the accepted presentation that those degrees are outside the target or vanish.
